name: Holm Light
offer: A rechargeable storm lantern with 72 hours of warm light, for sailors and cabin owners.
audience: Sailors, cabin owners and anyone preparing for winter blackouts in the Nordics.

assets.alt: A lighthouse at dusk with its beam crossing the sea

sections.heading: Steady light for the dark half of the year.
body: Charge it once and it is ready for the next blackout.
